```artifact
Test Suite for GUI Event Graphs - Requirement U13_4

1. Add Symptom (TC-001)
   - GUI Event: Click 'Add Symptom' button
   - Follow-on Event: Enter Symptom Name
   - GUI Event: Enter Symptom Details
   - Follow-on Event: Confirm Symptom Details
   - GUI Event: Save Symptom
   - Follow-on Event: Symptom Added

2. View and Update Symptom Details (TC-002)
   - GUI Event: Select Symptom from list
   - Follow-on Event: Click 'Edit' button
   - GUI Event: Enter Symptom Details
   - Follow-on Event: Confirm Symptom Details
   - GUI Event: Save Symptom
   - Follow-on Event: Symptom Updated

3. Delete Symptom Details (TC-003)
   - GUI Event: Select Symptom from list
   - Follow-on Event: Click 'Delete' button
   - GUI Event: Confirm Symptom Deletion
   - Follow-on Event: Symptom Deleted
   - Precondition: No Consultation Request with Symptom

4. Select Symptom during Consultation Request (TC-004)
   - GUI Event: Patient selects Symptom from list during Consultation Request
   - Follow-on Event: Consultation Request raised

5. Negative Test for Deletion (TC-005)
   - GUI Event: Select Symptom from list
   - Follow-on Event: Click 'Delete' button
   - GUI Event: Confirm Symptom Deletion
   - Precondition: Symptom used in Consultation Request
   - Expected: Error message "Cannot delete Symptom"

6. Boundary Test for Empty Symptom List (TC-006)
   - GUI Event: Select Symptom from list
   - Follow-on Event: Confirm Symptom Deletion
   - Precondition: Symptom list is empty
   - Expected: Error message "Cannot delete Symptom"

7. Boundary Test for Duplicate Symptom Addition (TC-007)
   - GUI Event: Select Symptom from list
   - Follow-on Event: Confirm Symptom Deletion
   - Precondition: Symptom already exists in list
   - Expected: Error message "Cannot add Symptom"
